clips.title: The story
paras: In Tirisfal Glades, spiders have overrun Night Web's Hollow, an abandoned gold mine northwest of Deathknell. Newly raised Forsaken are sent into its tunnels to cull the vermin and prove their readiness for combat.

Night Web's Hollow lies in the hills northwest of Deathknell. Before the plague swept through Lordaeron, humans worked its gold mine. After the kingdom fell, the shafts stood empty. Now webs cover the rock walls, and aggressive night web spiders fill the vale and tunnels. The Forsaken send their newly raised into the hollow to kill young and adult spiders and regain access to the mine's gold.
